title: Impact of Recent MediShield Life Coverage Revisions on Out-of-Pocket Payments for Cancer Treatment and Drugs
what_it_is: Impact of Recent MediShield Life Coverage Revisions on Out-of-Pocket Payments for Cancer Treatment and Drugs

sections.label: Cancer Drug List price cuts
sections.summary: The Cancer Drug List gave MOH leverage to lower cancer drug prices, cutting them by an average of 30% and covering about 90% of HSA-approved cancer drug treatments.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: To reiterate, the Cancer Drug List (CDL) conferred negotiating leverage to the Ministry of Health (MOH), to lower the prices of commonly used and effective cancer drugs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Since its implementation, we have brought down CDL drug prices by an average of 30% and over 60% for some drugs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Today, the CDL covers about 90% of Health Science Authority (HSA)-approved cancer drug treatments in Singapore.

sections.label: Transfer to subsidised public care
sections.summary: Patients seeing private doctors may transfer to subsidised public hospital care, where additional MediSave and financial assistance will be explored, so no one is denied care for inability to pay.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: If both are not possible and the patient is seeing a private doctor, the patient can consider transferring to subsidised care under public hospitals, where we will also explore the possibility of using additional MediSave and availing other forms of financial assistance.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We are committed to ensuring that no one will be denied of appropriate care due to an inability to pay.

sections.label: MediSave limit for co-insurance
sections.summary: The MediSave limit is usually sized to cover the 10% co-insurance of MediShield Life for treatments and the CDL.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The MediSave limit is usually sized to cover the 10% co-insurance of MediShield Life for treatments and the CDL.

sections.label: MediShield Life services limit raised
sections.summary: After reviewing latest data, the services limit was raised from $1,200 to $3,600, covering nine out of 10 subsidised bills in public healthcare institutions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: In respect of the question on MediShield Life, we have just done a review of the latest data available and we have raised the services limit quite substantially from $1,200 to $3,600.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: This would cover nine out of 10 subsidised bills in the Public Healthcare Institutions.
